from PyQt5.QtWidgets import (QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QFormLayout, QHBoxLayout, QSpinBox, QDoubleSpinBox, QPushButton, QLabel)
from PyQt5.QtCore import Qt
from utils.config import SimulationConfig
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.backends.backend_qt5agg import FigureCanvasQTAgg as FigureCanvas
import numpy as np

class InputWidget(QWidget):
    """Панель ввода параметров симуляции."""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout()
        self.setLayout(self.layout)

        # ---------- Блок 1 ----------
        block1 = QFormLayout()
        self.num_particles_spinbox = QSpinBox()
        self.num_particles_spinbox.setRange(1, 10000)
        self.num_particles_spinbox.setValue(100)

        self.particle_radius_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.particle_radius_spinbox.setDecimals(4)
        self.particle_radius_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.001)
        self.particle_radius_spinbox.setValue(0.02)

        self.particle_density_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.particle_density_spinbox.setDecimals(1)
        self.particle_density_spinbox.setSingleStep(100)
        self.particle_density_spinbox.setValue(2500.0)

        block1.addRow(QLabel("Количество частиц:"), self.num_particles_spinbox)
        block1.addRow(QLabel("Радиус частицы (м):"), self.particle_radius_spinbox)
        block1.addRow(QLabel("Плотность (кг/м³):"), self.particle_density_spinbox)

        # ---------- Блок 2 ----------
        block2 = QFormLayout()
        self.kn_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.kn_spinbox.setDecimals(0)
        self.kn_spinbox.setSingleStep(1e4)
        self.kn_spinbox.setValue(1e5)

        self.restitution_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.restitution_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.restitution_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.restitution_spinbox.setValue(0.9)

        self.friction_static_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.friction_static_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.friction_static_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.friction_static_spinbox.setValue(0.5)

        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.setValue(0.4)

        block2.addRow(QLabel("Жёсткость Kn (N/m):"), self.kn_spinbox)
        block2.addRow(QLabel("Коэффициент восстановления:"), self.restitution_spinbox)
        block2.addRow(QLabel("Статическое трение μs:"), self.friction_static_spinbox)
        block2.addRow(QLabel("Динамическое трение μd:"), self.friction_dynamic_spinbox)

        # ---------- Блок 3 ----------
        block3 = QFormLayout()
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.001)
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox.setValue(0.01)

        self.drum_radius_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.drum_radius_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.drum_radius_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.drum_radius_spinbox.setValue(0.5)

        self.drum_omega_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.drum_omega_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.drum_omega_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.1)
        self.drum_omega_spinbox.setValue(2.0)

        self.dt_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.dt_spinbox.setDecimals(7)
        self.dt_spinbox.setSingleStep(1e-6)
        self.dt_spinbox.setValue(1e-5)

        self.total_time_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.total_time_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.total_time_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.5)
        self.total_time_spinbox.setValue(5.0)

        block3.addRow(QLabel("Коэффициент качения μr:"), self.rolling_friction_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Радиус барабана (м):"), self.drum_radius_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Угловая скорость барабана (рад/с):"), self.drum_omega_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Шаг по времени Δt (с):"), self.dt_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Общее время (с):"), self.total_time_spinbox)

        # ---------- Блок 4 (лифтеры и центральная сфера) ----------
        block4 = QFormLayout()
        self.lifter_height_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.lifter_height_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.lifter_height_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.lifter_height_spinbox.setValue(0.1)

        self.lifter_count_spinbox = QSpinBox()
        self.lifter_count_spinbox.setRange(0, 36)
        self.lifter_count_spinbox.setValue(4)

        self.lifter_width_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.005)
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setValue(0.02)

        self.central_sphere_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setValue(0.02)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setSpecialValueText("0 = нет")

        block4.addRow(QLabel("Высота лифтеров (м):"), self.lifter_height_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Количество лифтеров:"), self.lifter_count_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Ширина лифтеров (м):"), self.lifter_width_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Радиус центр. сферы (м):"), self.central_sphere_spinbox)

        # ---------- Кнопка ----------
        button_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.apply_button = QPushButton("Применить")
        button_layout.addWidget(self.apply_button)

        # ---------- Предварительный просмотр ----------
        self.preview_fig, self.preview_ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4,4))
        self.preview_canvas = FigureCanvas(self.preview_fig)
        self.preview_canvas.setFixedSize(300, 300)
        self._draw_preview()  # начальная отрисовка

        # ---------- Сборка ----------
        self.layout.addLayout(block1)
        self.layout.addLayout(block2)
        self.layout.addLayout(block3)
        self.layout.addLayout(block4)
        self.layout.addLayout(button_layout)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.preview_canvas)

        # Подключаем обновление предварительного просмотра
        for spinbox in [self.drum_radius_spinbox, self.lifter_height_spinbox,
                        self.lifter_count_spinbox, self.lifter_width_spinbox,
                        self.central_sphere_spinbox]:
            spinbox.valueChanged.connect(self._draw_preview)

    def _draw_preview(self):
        """Отрисовывает барабан, лифтеры и центральную сферу."""
        self.preview_ax.clear()
        drum_r = self.drum_radius_spinbox.value()
        lifter_h = self.lifter_height_spinbox.value()
        lifter_count = self.lifter_count_spinbox.value()
        lifter_w = self.lifter_width_spinbox.value()
        sphere_r = self.central_sphere_spinbox.value()

        # Барабан
        drum_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), drum_r, color='gray', fill=False, linewidth=2)
        self.preview_ax.add_artist(drum_circle)

        # Лифтеры
        if lifter_count > 0 and lifter_h > 0:
            angles = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, lifter_count, endpoint=False)
            for angle in angles:
                # Прямоугольник лифтера: ширина (по окружности), высота (радиус)
                # Координаты центра прямоугольника: (drum_r - lifter_h/2) от центра
                cx = (drum_r - lifter_h/2) * np.cos(angle)
                cy = (drum_r - lifter_h/2) * np.sin(angle)
                # Размеры: ширина lifter_w (вдоль окружности), высота lifter_h (радиально)
                rect = plt.Rectangle((cx - lifter_w/2, cy - lifter_h/2),
                                     lifter_w, lifter_h,
                                     angle=np.degrees(angle),
                                     color='brown', alpha=0.7)
                self.preview_ax.add_artist(rect)

        # Центральная сфера
        if sphere_r > 0:
            sphere_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), sphere_r, color='green', alpha=0.5)
            self.preview_ax.add_artist(sphere_circle)

        self.preview_ax.set_xlim(-drum_r*1.1, drum_r*1.1)
        self.preview_ax.set_ylim(-drum_r*1.1, drum_r*1.1)
        self.preview_ax.set_aspect('equal')
        self.preview_ax.grid(True)
        self.preview_canvas.draw()

    def get_config(self) -> SimulationConfig:
        """Создаёт объект SimulationConfig из текущих значений виджетов."""
        return SimulationConfig(
            num_particles=self.num_particles_spinbox.value(),
            particle_radius=self.particle_radius_spinbox.value(),
            particle_density=self.particle_density_spinbox.value(),
            kn=self.kn_spinbox.value(),
            restitution_coeff=self.restitution_spinbox.value(),
            friction_static=self.friction_static_spinbox.value(),
            friction_dynamic=self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.value(),
            rolling_friction=self.rolling_friction_spinbox.value(),
            drum_radius=self.drum_radius_spinbox.value(),
            drum_omega=self.drum_omega_spinbox.value(),
            dt=self.dt_spinbox.value(),
            total_time=self.total_time_spinbox.value(),
            lifter_height=self.lifter_height_spinbox.value(),
            lifter_count=self.lifter_count_spinbox.value(),
            lifter_width=self.lifter_width_spinbox.value(),
            central_sphere_radius=self.central_sphere_spinbox.value()
        )

```python
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.005)
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setValue(0.02)

        self.central_sphere_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setValue(0.02)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setSpecialValueText("0 = нет")

        block4.addRow(QLabel("Высота лифтеров (м):"), self.lifter_height_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Количество лифтеров:"), self.lifter_count_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Ширина лифтеров (м):"), self.lifter_width_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Радиус центр. сферы (м):"), self.central_sphere_spinbox)

        # ---------- Кнопка ----------
        button_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.apply_button = QPushButton("Применить")
        button_layout.addWidget(self.apply_button)

        # ---------- Предварительный просмотр ----------
        self.preview_fig, self.preview_ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4,4))
        self.preview_canvas = FigureCanvas(self.preview_fig)
        self.preview_canvas.setFixedSize(300, 300)
        self._draw_preview()  # начальная отрисовка

        # ---------- Сборка ----------
        self.layout.addLayout(block1)
        self.layout.addLayout(block2)
        self.layout.addLayout(block3)
        self.layout.addLayout(block4)
        self.layout.addLayout(button_layout)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.preview_canvas)

        # Подключаем обновление предварительного просмотра
        for spinbox in [self.drum_radius_spinbox, self.lifter_height_spinbox,
                        self.lifter_count_spinbox, self.lifter_width_spinbox,
                        self.central_sphere_spinbox]:
            spinbox.valueChanged.connect(self._draw_preview)

    def _draw_preview(self):
        """Отрисовывает барабан, лифтеры и центральную сферу."""
        self.preview_ax.clear()
        drum_r = self.drum_radius_spinbox.value()
        lifter_h = self.lifter_height_spinbox.value()
        lifter_count = self.lifter_count_spinbox.value()
        lifter_w = self.lifter_width_spinbox.value()
        sphere_r = self.central_sphere_spinbox.value()

        # Барабан
        drum_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), drum_r, color='gray', fill=False, linewidth=2)
        self.preview_ax.add_artist(drum_circle)

        # Лифтеры
        if lifter_count > 0 and lifter_h > 0:
            angles = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, lifter_count, endpoint=False)
            for angle in angles:
                # Прямоугольник лифтера: ширина (по окружности), высота (радиус)
                # Координаты центра прямоугольника: (drum_r - lifter_h/2) от центра
                cx = (drum_r - lifter_h/2) * np.cos(angle)
                cy = (drum_r - lifter_h/2) * np.sin(angle)
                # Размеры: ширина lifter_w (вдоль окружности), высота lifter_h (радиально)
                rect = plt.Rectangle((cx - lifter_w/2, cy - lifter_h/2),
                                     lifter_w, lifter_h,
                                     angle=np.degrees(angle),
                                     color='brown', alpha=0.7)
                self.preview_ax.add_artist(rect)

        # Центральная сфера
        if sphere_r > 0:
            sphere_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), sphere_r, color='green', alpha=0.5)
            self.preview_ax.add_artist(sphere_circle)

        self.preview_ax.set_xlim(-drum_r*1.1, drum_r*1.1)
        self.preview_ax.set_ylim(-drum_r*1.1, drum_r*1.1)
        self.preview_ax.set_aspect('equal')
        self.preview_ax.grid(True)
        self.preview_canvas.draw()

    def get_config(self) -> SimulationConfig:
        """Создаёт объект SimulationConfig из текущих значений виджетов."""
        return SimulationConfig(
            num_particles=self.num_particles_spinbox.value(),
            particle_radius=self.particle_radius_spinbox.value(),
            particle_density=self.particle_density_spinbox.value(),
            kn=self.kn_spinbox.value(),
            restitution_coeff=self.restitution_spinbox.value(),
            friction_static=self.friction_static_spinbox.value(),
            friction_dynamic=self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.value(),
            rolling_friction=self.rolling_friction_spinbox.value(),
            drum_radius=self.drum_radius_spinbox.value(),
            drum_omega=self.drum_omega_spinbox.value(),
            dt=self.dt_spinbox.value(),
            total_time=self.total_time_spinbox.value(),
            lifter_height=self.lifter_height_spinbox.value(),
            lifter_count=self.lifter_count_spinbox.value(),
            lifter_width=self.lifter_width_spinbox.value(),
            central_sphere_radius=self.central_sphere_spinbox.value()
        )
```

**utils/config.py**
```python
"""Конфигурационные параметры симуляции DEM.

Все параметры задаются в системе СИ. Датакласс `SimulationConfig` хранит
значения по умолчанию, которые могут быть переопределены через GUI.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class SimulationConfig:
    """Параметры симуляции.

    При необходимости пользователь может изменить любые поля через GUI.
    """
    num_particles: int = 100
    particle_radius: float = 0.02          # м
    particle_density: float = 2500.0       # кг/м³
    kn: float = 1e5                        # N/m
    restitution_coeff: float = 0.9         # коэффициент восстановления
    friction_static: float = 0.5           # μ_s
    friction_dynamic: float = 0.4          # μ_d
    rolling_friction: float = 0.01         # μ_r
    drum_radius: float = 0.5                # м
    drum_omega: float = 2.0                 # рад/с
    dt: float = 1e-5                       # с
    total_time: float = 5.0                # с

    # Параметры лифтеров (выступающие пластины)
    lifter_height: float = 0.1            # м – высота выступа внутрь
    lifter_count: int = 4                 # количество лифтеров
    lifter_width: float = 0.02            # м – ширина (вдоль окружности)

    # Параметр центральной сферы (если 0 – отсутствует)
    central_sphere_radius: float = 0.02   # м
```

from PyQt5.QtWidgets import (QWidget, QVBoxLayout, QFormLayout, QHBoxLayout, QSpinBox, QDoubleSpinBox, QPushButton, QLabel)
from PyQt5.QtCore import Qt
from utils.config import SimulationConfig
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.backends.backend_qt5agg import FigureCanvasQTAgg as FigureCanvas
import numpy as np

class InputWidget(QWidget):
    """Панель ввода параметров симуляции."""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.layout = QVBoxLayout()
        self.setLayout(self.layout)

        # ---------- Блок 1 ----------
        block1 = QFormLayout()

        self.particle_radius_spinbox.setValue(0.02)

        self.particle_density_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.particle_density_spinbox.setDecimals(1)
        self.particle_density_spinbox.setSingleStep(100)
        self.particle_density_spinbox.setValue(2500.0)

        block1.addRow(QLabel("Количество частиц:"), self.num_particles_spinbox)
        block1.addRow(QLabel("Радиус частицы (м):"), self.particle_radius_spinbox)
        block1.addRow(QLabel("Плотность (кг/м³):"), self.particle_density_spinbox)

        # ---------- Блок 2 ----------
        block2 = QFormLayout()
        self.kn_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.kn_spinbox.setDecimals(0)
        self.kn_spinbox.setSingleStep(1e4)

        self.restitution_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.restitution_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.restitution_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.restitution_spinbox.setValue(0.9)

        self.friction_static_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.friction_static_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.friction_static_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.friction_static_spinbox.setValue(0.5)

        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.05)
        self.friction_dynamic_spinbox.setValue(0.4)

        block2.addRow(QLabel("Жёсткость Kn (N/m):"), self.kn_spinbox)
        block2.addRow(QLabel("Коэффициент восстановления:"), self.restitution_spinbox)
        block2.addRow(QLabel("Статическое трение μs:"), self.friction_static_spinbox)
        block2.addRow(QLabel("Динамическое трение μd:"), self.friction_dynamic_spinbox)

        # ---------- Блок 3 ----------
        block3 = QFormLayout()
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.001)
        self.rolling_friction_spinbox.setValue(0.01)

        self.drum_radius_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.drum_radius_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.drum_radius_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.drum_radius_spinbox.setValue(0.5)

        self.drum_omega_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.drum_omega_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.drum_omega_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.1)
        self.drum_omega_spinbox.setValue(2.0)

        self.dt_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.dt_spinbox.setDecimals(7)
        self.dt_spinbox.setSingleStep(1e-6)
        self.dt_spinbox.setValue(1e-5)

        self.total_time_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.total_time_spinbox.setDecimals(2)
        self.total_time_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.5)
        self.total_time_spinbox.setValue(5.0)

        block3.addRow(QLabel("Коэффициент качения μr:"), self.rolling_friction_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Радиус барабана (м):"), self.drum_radius_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Угловая скорость барабана (рад/с):"), self.drum_omega_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Шаг по времени Δt (с):"), self.dt_spinbox)
        block3.addRow(QLabel("Общее время (с):"), self.total_time_spinbox)

        # ---------- Блок 4 (лифтеры и центральная сфера) ----------
        block4 = QFormLayout()
        self.lifter_height_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.lifter_height_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.lifter_height_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.lifter_height_spinbox.setValue(0.1)

        self.lifter_count_spinbox = QSpinBox()
        self.lifter_count_spinbox.setRange(0, 36)
        self.lifter_count_spinbox.setValue(4)

        self.lifter_width_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.005)
        self.lifter_width_spinbox.setValue(0.02)

        self.central_sphere_spinbox = QDoubleSpinBox()
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setDecimals(3)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setSingleStep(0.01)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setValue(0.02)
        self.central_sphere_spinbox.setSpecialValueText("0 = нет")

        block4.addRow(QLabel("Высота лифтеров (м):"), self.lifter_height_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Количество лифтеров:"), self.lifter_count_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Ширина лифтеров (м):"), self.lifter_width_spinbox)
        block4.addRow(QLabel("Радиус центр. сферы (м):"), self.central_sphere_spinbox)

        # ---------- Кнопка ----------
        button_layout = QHBoxLayout()
        self.apply_button = QPushButton("Применить")
        button_layout.addWidget(self.apply_button)

        # ---------- Предварительный просмотр ----------
        self.preview_fig, self.preview_ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4,4))
        self.preview_canvas = FigureCanvas(self.preview_fig)
        self.preview_canvas.setFixedSize(300, 300)
        self._draw_preview()  # начальная отрисовка

        # ---------- Сборка ----------
        self.layout.addLayout(block1)
        self.layout.addLayout(block2)
        self.layout.addLayout(block3)
        self.layout.addLayout(block4)
        self.layout.addLayout(button_layout)
        self.layout.addWidget(self.preview_canvas)

        # Подключаем обновление предварительного просмотра
        for spinbox in [self.drum_radius_spinbox, self.lifter_height_spinbox,
                        self.lifter_count_spinbox, self.lifter_width_spinbox,
                        self.central_sphere_spinbox]:
            spinbox.valueChanged.connect(self._draw_preview)

    def _draw_preview(self):
        """Отрисовывает барабан, лифтеры и центральную сферу."""
        self.preview_ax.clear()
        drum_r = self.drum_radius_spinbox.value()
        lifter_h = self.lifter_height_spinbox.value()

```python
class WallCircle(Boundary):
    def __init__(self, center, radius, omega=0.0,
                 lifter_count=0, lifter_height=0.0, lifter_width=0.0):
        self.center = np.array(center, dtype=float)
        self.radius = radius
        self.omega = omega
        self.angle = 0.0   # текущий угол поворота барабана
        self.lifter_count = lifter_count
        self.lifter_height = lifter_height  # радиальный выступ внутрь
        self.lifter_width = lifter_width    # ширина (хорда) лифтера
        self.applied_torque = 0.0

    def _lifter_collision(self, particle):
        # для каждого лифтера
        best = None
        base_angles = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, self.lifter_count, endpoint=False)
        # лифтеры вращаются вместе с барабаном -> их угол = base_angle + self.angle
        for base_angle in base_angles:
            angle = base_angle + self.angle
            # отрезок внутренней стороны лифтера
            # радиус внутренней части
            r_inner = self.radius - self.lifter_height
            if r_inner < 0:
                continue
            half_width = self.lifter_width / 2.0
            # центр отрезка на линии радиус-вектора
            # концы отрезка в касательном направлении
            # касательный единичный вектор (perpendicular)
            perp = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle)])  # поворот на 90 градусов
            central_point = self.center + r_inner * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)])
            p1 = central_point + half_width * perp
            p2 = central_point - half_width * perp
            # далее коллизия с отрезком
            # преобразуем в WallLine с нормалью к центру
            # нормаль направлена от отрезка к центру (т.е. от центра отрезка внутрь барабана)
            # найдем ближайшую точку к частице на отрезке
            # проекция
            vec = particle.pos - p1
            seg = p2 - p1
            seg_len = np.linalg.norm(seg)
            if seg_len < 1e-12:
                continue
            seg_unit = seg / seg_len
            t = np.dot(vec, seg_unit)
            t = np.clip(t, 0.0, seg_len)
            closest = p1 + t * seg_unit
            dist_vec = particle.pos - closest
            dist = np.linalg.norm(dist_vec)
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            if overlap <= 0:
                continue
            # нормаль от отрезка к центру частицы (внутрь барабана)
            # если частица снаружи отрезка (внутри барабана) – нормаль к центру
            # но лифтер с внутренней стороны (смотрит к центру)
            # используем radial inward vector от центра отрезка
            # лучше определить нормаль как единичный вектор от отрезка к центру барабана
            # центр -> vector from center to central_point – направлен наружу.
            # Нормаль от отрезка к центру – противоположная.
            # Более надёжно: нормаль = (center - closest) / |...|
            normal = self.center - closest
            norm_len = np.linalg.norm(normal)
            if norm_len < 1e-12:
                normal = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
            else:
                normal /= norm_len
            overlap_rate = np.dot(particle.vel, -normal)  # overlap_rate = -v.normal
            # tangential velocity
            tangential_velocity = particle.vel - overlap_rate * (-normal) # исправим
            # лучше использовать rel_vel относительно поверхности барабана? У лифтера тоже скорость от вращения.
            # Скорость точки отрезка в контакте: v_surface = omega x (closest - center)
            # cross2d: omega x r = [-omega * ry, omega * rx] (в 2D)
            surface_vel = np.array([-self.omega * (closest[1] - self.center[1]),
                                     self.omega * (closest[0] - self.center[0])])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)  # positive when moving into wall
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal
            # теперь возвращаем кортеж как для WallCircle
            contact_point = closest
            if best is None or overlap > best[0]:
                best = (overlap, contact_point, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)
        return best

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # сначала коллизия с основным кругом
        vec = particle.pos - self.center
        dist = np.linalg.norm(vec)
        if dist > self.radius + particle.radius:
            circle_coll = None
        else:
            overlap_circle = self.radius + particle.radius - dist
            if dist == 0.0:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
                contact_point = self.center + self.radius * normal
            else:
                normal = vec / dist
                contact_point = self.center + (self.radius / dist) * vec
            surface_vel = np.array([-self.omega * (contact_point[1] - self.center[1]),
                                    self.omega * (contact_point[0] - self.center[0])])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal
            circle_coll = (overlap_circle, contact_point, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)
        # коллизия с лифтерами
        lifter_coll = self._lifter_collision(particle) if self.lifter_count > 0 else None
        # выбираем с максимальным overlap
        best = circle_coll
        if lifter_coll is not None:
            if best is None or lifter_coll[0] > best[0]:
                best = lifter_coll
        return best

    # оставляем apply_driving_torque
```

### 2. `dem/geometry.py`
Класс `WallCircle` дополнен:

- хранением параметров лифтеров и текущего угла (`self.angle`);
- методом `_lifter_collision`, проверяющим столкновение частицы с каждым лифтером (как с конечным отрезком);
- изменённый `detect_collision` выбирает контакт с максимальным перекрытием (основной круг или лифтер).

```python
import numpy as np

class Boundary:
    """Базовый класс границы."""
    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement detect_collision.")

class WallLine(Boundary):
    """Прямая стенка, ограничивающая область с внутренней стороны против нормали."""
    def __init__(self, point, normal):
        self.point = np.array(point, dtype=float)
        self.normal = np.array(normal, dtype=float)
        self.normal /= np.linalg.norm(self.normal)

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # Расстояние от центра частицы до линии (положительно – в сторону нормали)
        dist = np.dot(particle.pos - self.point, self.normal)

        if dist > 0:
            return None  # нет контакта

        overlap = particle.radius - dist
        contact_point = particle.pos - overlap * self.normal
        normal_unit_vector = -self.normal
        overlap_rate = np.dot(particle.vel, self.normal)
        tangential_velocity = particle.vel - overlap_rate * self.normal

        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

class WallCircle(Boundary):
    """Вращающийся барабан (окружность) с опциональными лифтерами."""
    def __init__(self, center, radius, omega=0.0,
                 lifter_count=0, lifter_height=0.0, lifter_width=0.0):
        self.center = np.array(center, dtype=float)
        self.radius = radius
        self.omega = omega                # угловая скорость барабана
        self.angle = 0.0                  # текущий угол поворота
        self.lifter_count = lifter_count
        self.lifter_height = lifter_height
        self.lifter_width = lifter_width
        self.applied_torque = 0.0         # реактивный момент от частиц

    def _lifter_collision(self, particle):
        """Возвращает контакт с лифтером (если есть) в том же формате, что detect_collision."""
        best = None
        base_angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, self.lifter_count, endpoint=False)
        for base_angle in base_angles:
            angle = base_angle + self.angle
            r_inner = self.radius - self.lifter_height
            if r_inner < 0:
                continue
            half_width = self.lifter_width / 2.0
            # единичные векторы радиального и касательного направлений
            radial = np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)])
            perp = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle)])  # касательное (поворот на 90°)
            # центральная точка отрезка (внутренняя грань лифтера)
            central = self.center + r_inner * radial
            p1 = central + half_width * perp
            p2 = central - half_width * perp

            # проекция частицы на отрезок
            seg = p2 - p1
            seg_len = np.linalg.norm(seg)
            if seg_len < 1e-12:
                continue
            seg_unit = seg / seg_len
            t = np.dot(particle.pos - p1, seg_unit)
            t = np.clip(t, 0.0, seg_len)
            closest = p1 + t * seg_unit

            dist_vec = particle.pos - closest
            dist = np.linalg.norm(dist_vec)
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            if overlap <= 0:
                continue

            # нормаль от отрезка к центру барабана (внутрь)
            normal = self.center - closest
            norm_len = np.linalg.norm(normal)
            if norm_len < 1e-12:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
            else:
                normal /= norm_len

            # скорость поверхности лифтера в точке контакта (вращение барабана)
            surface_vel = np.array([
                -self.omega * (closest[1] - self.center[1]),
                 self.omega * (closest[0] - self.center[0])
            ])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal

            if best is None or overlap > best[0]:
                best = (overlap, closest, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)
        return best

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        """Возвращает контакт с перекрытием (максимальное из круга и лифтеров)."""
        # -- контакт с основным кругом --
        vec = particle.pos - self.center
        dist = np.linalg.norm(vec)
        circle_coll = None
        if dist <= self.radius + particle.radius:
            overlap_circle = self.radius + particle.radius - dist
            if dist == 0.0:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
                contact_point = self.center + self.radius * normal
            else:
                normal = vec / dist
                contact_point = self.center + (self.radius / dist) * vec
            surface_vel = np.array([
                -self.omega * (contact_point[1] - self.center[1]),
                 self.omega * (contact_point[0] - self.center[0])
            ])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal
            circle_coll = (overlap_circle, contact_point, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)

        # -- контакт с лифтерами --
        lifter_coll = self._lifter_collision(particle) if self.lifter_count > 0 else None

        # выбираем с большим перекрытием
        best = circle_coll
        if lifter_coll is not None:
            if best is None or lifter_coll[0] > best[0]:
                best = lifter_coll
        return best

    def apply_driving_torque(self, torque):
        """Накопление реактивного момента, который необходимо компенсировать."""
        self.applied_torque += torque
```

```
"""Конфигурационные параметры симуляции DEM.

Все параметры задаются в системе СИ. Датакласс `SimulationConfig` хранит
значения по умолчанию, которые могут быть переопределены через GUI.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class SimulationConfig:
    """Параметры симуляции.

    При необходимости пользователь может изменить любые поля через GUI.
    """
    num_particles: int = 100
    particle_radius: float = 0.02          # м
    particle_density: float = 2500.0       # кг/м³
    kn: float = 1e5                        # N/m
    restitution_coeff: float = 0.9         # коэффициент восстановления
    friction_static: float = 0.5           # μ_s
    friction_dynamic: float = 0.4          # μ_d
    rolling_friction: float = 0.01         # μ_r
    drum_radius: float = 0.5                # м
    drum_omega: float = 2.0                 # рад/с
    dt: float = 1e-5                       # с
    total_time: float = 5.0                # с
    # ----- Лифтеры -----
    lifter_height: float = 0.1             # м, радиальный выступ внутрь
    lifter_width: float = 0.02             # м, ширина (касательный размер)
    lifter_count: int = 4                  # количество лифтеров
```

```
import numpy as np

class Boundary:
    """Базовый класс границы."""
    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement detect_collision.")

class WallLine(Boundary):
    """Прямая стенка, ограничивающая область с внутренней стороны против нормали."""
    def __init__(self, point, normal):
        self.point = np.array(point, dtype=float)
        self.normal = np.array(normal, dtype=float)
        self.normal /= np.linalg.norm(self.normal)

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # Расстояние от центра частицы до линии (положительно – в сторону нормали)
        dist = np.dot(particle.pos - self.point, self.normal)

        if dist > 0:
            return None  # нет контакта

        overlap = particle.radius - dist
        contact_point = particle.pos - overlap * self.normal
        normal_unit_vector = -self.normal
        overlap_rate = np.dot(particle.vel, self.normal)
        tangential_velocity = particle.vel - overlap_rate * self.normal

        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

class WallCircle(Boundary):
    """Вращающийся барабан (окружность) с опциональными лифтерами."""
    def __init__(self, center, radius, omega=0.0,
                 lifter_count=0, lifter_height=0.0, lifter_width=0.0):
        self.center = np.array(center, dtype=float)
        self.radius = radius
        self.omega = omega                # угловая скорость барабана
        self.angle = 0.0                  # текущий угол поворота
        self.lifter_count = lifter_count
        self.lifter_height = lifter_height
        self.lifter_width = lifter_width
        self.applied_torque = 0.0         # реактивный момент от частиц

    def _lifter_collision(self, particle):
        """Возвращает контакт с лифтером (если есть) в том же формате, что detect_collision."""
        best = None
        base_angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, self.lifter_count, endpoint=False)
        for base_angle in base_angles:
            angle = base_angle + self.angle
            r_inner = self.radius - self.lifter_height
            if r_inner < 0:
                continue
            half_width = self.lifter_width / 2.0
            # единичные векторы радиального и касательного направлений
            radial = np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)])
            perp = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle)])  # касательное (поворот на 90°)
            # центральная точка отрезка (внутренняя грань лифтера)
            central = self.center + r_inner * radial
            p1 = central + half_width * perp
            p2 = central - half_width * perp

            # проекция частицы на отрезок
            seg = p2 - p1
            seg_len = np.linalg.norm(seg)
            if seg_len < 1e-12:
                continue
            seg_unit = seg / seg_len
            t = np.dot(particle.pos - p1, seg_unit)
            t = np.clip(t, 0.0, seg_len)
            closest = p1 + t * seg_unit

            dist_vec = particle.pos - closest
            dist = np.linalg.norm(dist_vec)
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            if overlap <= 0:
                continue

            # нормаль от отрезка к центру барабана (внутрь)
            normal = self.center - closest
            norm_len = np.linalg.norm(normal)
            if norm_len < 1e-12:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
            else:
                normal /= norm_len

            # скорость поверхности лифтера в точке контакта (вращение барабана)
            surface_vel = np.array([
                -self.omega * (closest[1] - self.center[1]),
                 self.omega * (closest[0] - self.center[0])
            ])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal

            if best is None or overlap > best[0]:
                best = (overlap, closest, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)
        return best

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        """Возвращает контакт с перекрытием (максимальное из круга и лифтеров)."""
        # -- контакт с основным кругом --
        vec = particle.pos - self.center
        dist = np.linalg.norm(vec)
        circle_coll = None
        if dist <= self.radius + particle.radius:
            overlap_circle = self.radius + particle.radius - dist
            if dist == 0.0:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
                contact_point = self.center + self.radius * normal
            else:
                normal = vec / dist
                contact_point = self.center + (self.radius / dist) * vec
            surface_vel = np.array([
                -self.omega * (contact_point[1] - self.center[1]),
                 self.omega * (contact_point[0] - self.center[0])
            ])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal
            circle_coll = (overlap_circle, contact_point, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)

        # -- контакт с лифтерами --
        lifter_coll = self._lifter_collision(particle) if self.lifter_count > 0 else None

        # выбираем с большим перекрытием
        best = circle_coll
        if lifter_coll is not None:
            if best is None or lifter_coll[0] > best[0]:
                best = lifter_coll
        return best

    def apply_driving_torque(self, torque):
        """Накопление реактивного момента, который необходимо компенсировать."""
        self.applied_torque += torque
```

```
import numpy as np
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import List

from .particle import Particle
from .contact_model import ContactModel, Contact
from .geometry import WallCircle
from .integrator import velocity_verlet_step
from .force_calculation import compute_all_forces
from utils.config import SimulationConfig


@dataclass
class Simulation:
    """Главный класс симуляции."""
    config: SimulationConfig
    particles: List[Particle] = field(default_factory=list)
    boundaries: List[object] = field(default_factory=list)
    contact_model: ContactModel = None
    time: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    torque_history: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    contacts: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    stop_requested: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.contact_model = ContactModel(
            kn=self.config.kn,
            restitution_coeff=self.config.restitution_coeff,
            mu_s=self.config.friction_static,
            mu_d=self.config.friction_dynamic,
            rolling_friction_coeff=self.config.rolling_friction,
            dt=self.config.dt,
            config=self.config
        )
        self.initialize_particles()
        self.initialize_boundaries()

    def initialize_particles(self):
        """Размещает частицы внутри барабана без перекрытий (hexagonal packing и случайные)."""
        R = self.config.drum_radius - self.config.particle_radius - 1e-4
        particle_diameter = 2 * self.config.particle_radius
        num_rows = int(np.sqrt(R**2 / (3 * particle_diameter**2)))
        num_cols = int(num_rows)
        count = 0
        for i in range(num_rows):
            for j in range(num_cols):
                if count >= self.config.num_particles:
                    break
                x_offset = 0.5 * particle_diameter * (i % 2)
                x = x_offset + j * particle_diameter
                y = np.sqrt(3) / 2 * i * particle_diameter
                pos = np.array([x, y])
                mass = self.config.particle_density * np.pi * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
                inertia = 0.5 * mass * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
                particle = Particle(
                    id=count,
                    radius=self.config.particle_radius,
                    density=self.config.particle_density,
                    mass=mass,
                    inertia=inertia,
                    pos=pos,
                    vel=np.zeros(2),
                    ang_vel=0.0,
                    history=[pos.copy()]
                )
                self.particles.append(particle)
                count += 1

        while count < self.config.num_particles:
            angle = np.random.rand() * 2 * np.pi
            rad = np.random.rand() * (R - self.config.particle_radius) + self.config.particle_radius
            pos = np.array([rad * np.cos(angle), rad * np.sin(angle)])
            if any(np.linalg.norm(pos - p.pos) < 2 * self.config.particle_radius for p in self.particles):
                continue
            mass = self.config.particle_density * np.pi * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
            inertia = 0.5 * mass * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
            particle = Particle(
                id=count,
                radius=self.config.particle_radius,
                density=self.config.particle_density,
                mass=mass,
                inertia=inertia,
                pos=pos,
                vel=np.zeros(2),
                ang_vel=0.0,
                history=[pos.copy()]
            )
            self.particles.append(particle)
            count += 1

    def initialize_boundaries(self):
        """Создаёт единственную границу – вращающийся барабан с лифтерами."""
        self.boundaries.append(
            WallCircle(
                center=(0.0, 0.0),
                radius=self.config.drum_radius,
                omega=self.config.drum_omega,
                lifter_count=self.config.lifter_count,
                lifter_height=self.config.lifter_height,
                lifter_width=self.config.lifter_width
            )
        )
```

"""Конфигурационные параметры симуляции DEM.

Все параметры задаются в системе СИ. Датакласс `SimulationConfig` хранит
значения по умолчанию, которые могут быть переопределены через GUI.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class SimulationConfig:
    """Параметры симуляции.

    При необходимости пользователь может изменить любые поля через GUI.
    """
    num_particles: int = 100
    particle_radius: float = 0.02          # м
    particle_density: float = 2500.0       # кг/м³
    kn: float = 1e5                        # N/m
    restitution_coeff: float = 0.9         # коэффициент восстановления
    friction_static: float = 0.5           # μ_s
    friction_dynamic: float = 0.4          # μ_d
    rolling_friction: float = 0.01         # μ_r
    drum_radius: float = 0.5                # м
    drum_omega: float = 2.0                 # рад/с
    dt: float = 1e-5                       # с
    total_time: float = 5.0                # с
    # ----- Лифтеры -----
    lifter_height: float = 0.1             # м, радиальный выступ внутрь
    lifter_width: float = 0.02             # м, ширина (касательный размер)
    lifter_count: int = 4                  # количество лифтеров

import numpy as np

class Boundary:
    """Базовый класс границы."""
    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement detect_collision.")

class WallLine(Boundary):
    """Прямая стенка, ограничивающая область с внутренней стороны против нормали."""
    def __init__(self, point, normal):
        self.point = np.array(point, dtype=float)
        self.normal = np.array(normal, dtype=float)
        self.normal /= np.linalg.norm(self.normal)

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # Расстояние от центра частицы до линии (положительно – в сторону нормали)
        dist = np.dot(particle.pos - self.point, self.normal)

        if dist > 0:
            return None  # нет контакта

        overlap = particle.radius - dist
        contact_point = particle.pos - overlap * self.normal
        normal_unit_vector = -self.normal
        overlap_rate = np.dot(particle.vel, self.normal)
        tangential_velocity = particle.vel - overlap_rate * self.normal

        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

class WallCircle(Boundary):
    """Вращающийся барабан (окружность) с опциональными лифтерами."""
    def __init__(self, center, radius, omega=0.0,
                 lifter_count=0, lifter_height=0.0, lifter_width=0.0):
        self.center = np.array(center, dtype=float)
        self.radius = radius
        self.omega = omega                # угловая скорость барабана
        self.angle = 0.0                  # текущий угол поворота
        self.lifter_count = lifter_count
        self.lifter_height = lifter_height
        self.lifter_width = lifter_width
        self.applied_torque = 0.0         # реактивный момент от частиц

    def _lifter_collision(self, particle):
        """Возвращает контакт с лифтером (если есть) в том же формате, что detect_collision."""
        best = None
        base_angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, self.lifter_count, endpoint=False)
        for base_angle in base_angles:
            angle = base_angle + self.angle
            r_inner = self.radius - self.lifter_height
            if r_inner < 0:
                continue
            half_width = self.lifter_width / 2.0
            # единичные векторы радиального и касательного направлений
            radial = np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)])
            perp = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle)])  # касательное (поворот на 90°)
            # центральная точка отрезка (внутренняя грань лифтера)
            central = self.center + r_inner * radial
            p1 = central + half_width * perp
            p2 = central - half_width * perp

            # проекция частицы на отрезок
            seg = p2 - p1
            seg_len = np.linalg.norm(seg)
            if seg_len < 1e-12:
                continue
            seg_unit = seg / seg_len
            t = np.dot(particle.pos - p1, seg_unit)
            t = np.clip(t, 0.0, seg_len)
            closest = p1 + t * seg_unit

            dist_vec = particle.pos - closest
            dist = np.linalg.norm(dist_vec)
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            if overlap <= 0:
                continue

            # нормаль от отрезка к центру барабана (внутрь)
            normal = self.center - closest
            norm_len = np.linalg.norm(normal)
            if norm_len < 1e-12:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
            else:
                normal /= norm_len

            # скорость поверхности лифтера в точке контакта (вращение барабана)
            surface_vel = np.array([
                -self.omega * (closest[1] - self.center[1]),
                 self.omega * (closest[0] - self.center[0])
            ])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal

            if best is None or overlap > best[0]:
                best = (overlap, closest, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)
        return best

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        """Возвращает контакт с перекрытием (максимальное из круга и лифтеров)."""
        # -- контакт с основным кругом --
        vec = particle.pos - self.center
        dist = np.linalg.norm(vec)
        circle_coll = None
        if dist <= self.radius + particle.radius:
            overlap_circle = self.radius + particle.radius - dist
            if dist == 0.0:
                normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
                contact_point = self.center + self.radius * normal
            else:
                normal = vec / dist
                contact_point = self.center + (self.radius / dist) * vec
            surface_vel = np.array([
                -self.omega * (contact_point[1] - self.center[1]),
                 self.omega * (contact_point[0] - self.center[0])
            ])
            rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
            overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
            tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal
            circle_coll = (overlap_circle, contact_point, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity)

        # -- контакт с лифтерами --
        lifter_coll = self._lifter_collision(particle) if self.lifter_count > 0 else None

        # выбираем с большим перекрытием
        best = circle_coll
        if lifter_coll is not None:
            if best is None or lifter_coll[0] > best[0]:
                best = lifter_coll
        return best

    def apply_driving_torque(self, torque):
        """Накопление реактивного момента, который необходимо компенсировать."""
        self.applied_torque += torque

Полный simulation.py:

```python
import numpy as np
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import List

from .particle import Particle
from .contact_model import ContactModel, Contact
from .geometry import WallCircle
from .integrator import velocity_verlet_step
from .force_calculation import compute_all_forces
from utils.config import SimulationConfig


@dataclass
class Simulation:
    """Главный класс симуляции."""
    config: SimulationConfig
    particles: List[Particle] = field(default_factory=list)
    boundaries: List[object] = field(default_factory=list)
    contact_model: ContactModel = None
    time: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    torque_history: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    contacts: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    stop_requested: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.contact_model = ContactModel(
            kn=self.config.kn,
            restitution_coeff=self.config.restitution_coeff,
            mu_s=self.config.friction_static,
            mu_d=self.config.friction_dynamic,
            rolling_friction_coeff=self.config.rolling_friction,
            dt=self.config.dt,
            config=self.config
        )
        self.initialize_particles()
        self.initialize_boundaries()

    def initialize_particles(self):
        """Размещает частицы внутри барабана без перекрытий (hexagonal packing и случайные)."""
        R = self.config.drum_radius - self.config.particle_radius - 1e-4
        particle_diameter = 2 * self.config.particle_radius
        num_rows = int(np.sqrt(R**2 / (3 * particle_diameter**2)))
        num_cols = int(num_rows)
        count = 0
        for i in range(num_rows):
            for j in range(num_cols):
                if count >= self.config.num_particles:
                    break
                x_offset = 0.5 * particle_diameter * (i % 2)
                x = x_offset + j * particle_diameter
                y = np.sqrt(3) / 2 * i * particle_diameter
                pos = np.array([x, y])
                mass = self.config.particle_density * np.pi * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
                inertia = 0.5 * mass * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
                particle = Particle(
                    id=count,
                    radius=self.config.particle_radius,
                    density=self.config.particle_density,
                    mass=mass,
                    inertia=inertia,
                    pos=pos,
                    vel=np.zeros(2),
                    ang_vel=0.0,
                    history=[pos.copy()]
                )
                self.particles.append(particle)
                count += 1

        while count < self.config.num_particles:
            angle = np.random.rand() * 2 * np.pi
            rad = np.random.rand() * (R - self.config.particle_radius) + self.config.particle_radius
            pos = np.array([rad * np.cos(angle), rad * np.sin(angle)])
            if any(np.linalg.norm(pos - p.pos) < 2 * self.config.particle_radius for p in self.particles):
                continue
            mass = self.config.particle_density * np.pi * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
            inertia = 0.5 * mass * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
            particle = Particle(
                id=count,
                radius=self.config.particle_radius,
                density=self.config.particle_density,
                mass=mass,
                inertia=inertia,
                pos=pos,
                vel=np.zeros(2),
                ang_vel=0.0,
                history=[pos.copy()]
            )
            self.particles.append(particle)
            count += 1

    def initialize_boundaries(self):
        """Создаёт единственную границу – вращающийся барабан с лифтерами."""
        self.boundaries.append(
            WallCircle(
                center=(0.0, 0.0),
                radius=self.config.drum_radius,
                omega=self.config.drum_omega,
                lifter_count=self.config.lifter_count,
                lifter_height=self.config.lifter_height,
                lifter_width=self.config.lifter_width
            )
        )

    def step(self):
        """Выполняет один временной шаг и сохраняет реактивный момент."""
        self.contacts = compute_all_forces(self.particles, self.boundaries, self.contact_model, self.contacts)

        velocity_verlet_step(self.particles, self.config.dt, self.contact_model, self.boundaries)

        drum = next((b for b in self.boundaries if isinstance(b, WallCircle)), None)
        if drum is not None:
            # Обновляем угол поворота барабана
            drum.angle += self.config.dt * drum.omega
            self.torque_history.append(-drum.applied_torque)
            drum.applied_torque = 0.0

    def run(self):
        """Запускает симуляцию до достижения total_time."""
        t = 0.0
        self.time.clear()
        self.torque_history.clear()
        step_count = 0
        while t < self.config.total_time and not self.stop_requested:
            self.step()
            self.time.append(t)
            t += self.config.dt
            step_count += 1
            if step_count % 10 == 0:
                print(f"Progress: {t / self.config.total_time * 100:.2f}%")

    def stop(self):
        """Запрашивает остановку симуляции."""
        self.stop_requested = True

    def get_trajectories(self):
        """Возвращает список историй всех частиц."""
        return [p.history for p in self.particles]
```

```python
def create_lifter_widget(self):
    widget = QGroupBox("Параметры лифтеров")
    layout = QFormLayout()
    self.lifter_count_spin = QSpinBox()
    self.lifter_count_spin.setRange(0, 20)
    self.lifter_count_spin.setValue(4)
    layout.addRow("Количество", self.lifter_count_spin)

    self.lifter_height_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
    self.lifter_height_spin.setRange(0.0, 1.0)
    self.lifter_height_spin.setDecimals(3)
    self.lifter_height_spin.setSingleStep(0.01)
    self.lifter_height_spin.setValue(0.1)
    layout.addRow("Высота, м", self.lifter_height_spin)

    self.lifter_width_spin = QDoubleSpinBox()
    self.lifter_width_spin.setRange(0.001, 0.2)
    self.lifter_width_spin.setDecimals(3)
```

import numpy as np
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import List

from .particle import Particle
from .contact_model import ContactModel, Contact
from .geometry import WallCircle
from .integrator import velocity_verlet_step
from .force_calculation import compute_all_forces
from utils.config import SimulationConfig


@dataclass
class Simulation:
    """Главный класс симуляции."""
    config: SimulationConfig
    particles: List[Particle] = field(default_factory=list)
    boundaries: List[object] = field(default_factory=list)
    contact_model: ContactModel = None
    time: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    torque_history: List[float] = field(default_factory=list)
    contacts: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    stop_requested: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.contact_model = ContactModel(
            kn=self.config.kn,
            restitution_coeff=self.config.restitution_coeff,
            mu_s=self.config.friction_static,
            mu_d=self.config.friction_dynamic,
            rolling_friction_coeff=self.config.rolling_friction,
            dt=self.config.dt,
            config=self.config
        )
        self.initialize_particles()
        self.initialize_boundaries()

    def initialize_particles(self):
        """Размещает частицы внутри барабана без перекрытий (hexagonal packing и случайные)."""
        R = self.config.drum_radius - self.config.particle_radius - 1e-4
        particle_diameter = 2 * self.config.particle_radius
        num_rows = int(np.sqrt(R**2 / (3 * particle_diameter**2)))
        num_cols = int(num_rows)
        count = 0
        for i in range(num_rows):
            for j in range(num_cols):
                if count >= self.config.num_particles:
                    break
                x_offset = 0.5 * particle_diameter * (i % 2)
                x = x_offset + j * particle_diameter
                y = np.sqrt(3) / 2 * i * particle_diameter
                pos = np.array([x, y])
                mass = self.config.particle_density * np.pi * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
                inertia = 0.5 * mass * (self.config.particle_radius ** 2)
                particle = Particle(
                    id=count,
                    radius=self.config.particle_radius,
                    density=self.config.particle_density,
                    mass=mass,
                    inertia=inertia,
                    pos=pos,
                    vel=np.zeros(2),
                    ang_vel=0.0,
                    history=[pos.copy()]
                )
                self.particles.append(particle)
                count += 1

        while count < self.config.num_particles:
            angle = np.random.rand() * 2 * np.pi
            rad = np.random.rand() * (R - self.config.particle_radius) + self.config.particle_radius
            pos = np.array([rad * np.cos(angle), rad * np.sin(angle)])
            if any(np.linalg.norm(pos - p.pos) < 2 * self.config.particle_radius for p in self.particles):
                continue

```python
class Lifter(Boundary):
    """Прямоугольный лифтер, жестко связанный с вращающимся барабаном."""
    def __init__(self, drum_center, drum_radius, height, width, base_angle, omega):
        self.drum_center = np.array(drum_center, dtype=float)
        self.drum_radius = drum_radius
        self.height = height
        self.width = width
        self.base_angle = base_angle
        self.omega = omega
        self.current_angle = base_angle
        self.applied_torque = 0.0
        
        # We will compute the 4 corners of the rectangle
        self._update_corners()

    def _update_corners(self):
        # The base of the lifter is on the drum wall.
        # Actually, the drum wall is at R. The lifter protrudes INWARD.
        # So the outer edge is at R, the inner edge is at R - height.
        r_out = self.drum_radius
        r_in = self.drum_radius - self.height
        
        # The angle spans around the base_angle.
        # Width is along the arc, but for simplicity (and typically lifters are thin compared to R),
        # we can define the width as a straight line or an arc.
        # Let's use a straight rectangle for simplicity, or an arc-based rectangle.
        # Straight rectangle:
        # Center of the base is at r_out, angle = current_angle.
        # Direction along the drum surface (tangent):
        tangent = np.array([-np.sin(self.current_angle), np.cos(self.current_angle)])
        normal_in = np.array([-np.cos(self.current_angle), -np.sin(self.current_angle)]) # pointing inward
        
        # Corners:
        # p1, p2: outer edge (on the drum)
        # p3, p4: inner edge (tip of the lifter)
        self.p1 = self.drum_center + r_out * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)]) - (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p2 = self.drum_center + r_out * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)]) + (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p3 = self.drum_center + r_in * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)]) + (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p4 = self.drum_center + r_in * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)]) - (self.width / 2) * tangent
        
        # For collision detection, we can treat the lifter as a polygon (rectangle).
        # The faces are:
        # Inner face (tip): p4 to p3
        # Left face: p1 to p4
        # Right face: p2 to p3
        # (Outer face p1-p2 is on the drum, no need to check, or we can just check all 4)
        
    def update_time(self, t):
        self.current_angle = self.base_angle + self.omega * t
        self._update_corners()

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # Find closest point on the rectangle to particle.pos
        # Since it's a convex polygon, we can check distance to all 4 line segments
        # and also check if the point is inside the polygon.
        
        # Let's define the 4 segments
        segments = [
            (self.p1, self.p2), # outer
            (self.p2, self.p3), # right
            (self.p3, self.p4), # inner
            (self.p4, self.p1)  # left
        ]
        
        min_dist_sq = float('inf')
        closest_pt = None
        
        for p_a, p_b in segments:
            pt = self._closest_point_on_segment(particle.pos, p_a, p_b)
            dist_sq = np.sum((particle.pos - pt)**2)
            if dist_sq < min_dist_sq:
                min_dist_sq = dist_sq
                closest_pt = pt
                
        dist = np.sqrt(min_dist_sq)
        
        # Check if particle center is inside the rectangle
        inside = self._is_inside(particle.pos)
        
        if not inside and dist >= particle.radius:
            return None
            
        if inside:
            # If inside, overlap is radius + dist to closest edge
            overlap = particle.radius + dist
            # Normal points from closest_pt to particle.pos (or outward if exactly on it)
            if dist > 1e-8:
                normal_unit_vector = (particle.pos - closest_pt) / dist
            else:
                # Fallback if exactly on the skeleton
                normal_unit_vector = np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
            contact_point = closest_pt
        else:
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            normal_unit_vector = (particle.pos - closest_pt) / dist
            contact_point = closest_pt
            
        # Surface velocity at contact point
        r_vec = contact_point - self.drum_center
        surface_vel = np.array([-self.omega * r_vec[1], self.omega * r_vec[0]])
        
        rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
        overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal_unit_vector)
        tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal_unit_vector
        
        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

    def _closest_point_on_segment(self, p, a, b):
        ab = b - a
        ap = p - a
        t = np.dot(ap, ab) / np.dot(ab, ab)
        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, t))
        return a + t * ab
        
    def _is_inside(self, p):
        # Cross product method for convex polygon
        # p1 -> p2 -> p3 -> p4
        pts = [self.p1, self.p2, self.p3, self.p4]
        n = len(pts)
        sign = None
        for i in range(n):
            a = pts[i]
            b = pts[(i+1)%n]
            cross = (b[0] - a[0]) * (p[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (p[0] - a[0])
            if sign is None:
                sign = cross > 0
            elif (cross > 0) != sign:
                return False
        return True
```

```python
class Lifter(Boundary):
    """Прямоугольный лифтер, жестко связанный с вращающимся барабаном."""
    def __init__(self, drum_center, drum_radius, height, width, base_angle, omega):
        self.drum_center = np.array(drum_center, dtype=float)
        self.drum_radius = drum_radius
        self.height = height
        self.width = width
        self.base_angle = base_angle
        self.omega = omega
        self.current_angle = base_angle
        self.applied_torque = 0.0
        
        self._update_corners()

    def _update_corners(self):
        r_out = self.drum_radius
        r_in = self.drum_radius - self.height
        
        tangent = np.array([-np.sin(self.current_angle), np.cos(self.current_angle)])
        
        center_out = self.drum_center + r_out * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
        center_in = self.drum_center + r_in * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
        
        self.p1 = center_out - (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p2 = center_out + (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p3 = center_in + (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p4 = center_in - (self.width / 2) * tangent

    def update_time(self, t):
        self.current_angle = self.base_angle + self.omega * t
        self._update_corners()

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        segments = [
            (self.p1, self.p2),
            (self.p2, self.p3),
            (self.p3, self.p4),
            (self.p4, self.p1)
        ]
        
        min_dist_sq = float('inf')
        closest_pt = None
        
        for p_a, p_b in segments:
            pt = self._closest_point_on_segment(particle.pos, p_a, p_b)
            dist_sq = np.sum((particle.pos - pt)**2)
            if dist_sq < min_dist_sq:
                min_dist_sq = dist_sq
                closest_pt = pt
                
        dist = np.sqrt(min_dist_sq)
        inside = self._is_inside(particle.pos)
        
        if not inside and dist >= particle.radius:
            return None
            
        if inside:
            overlap = particle.radius + dist
            if dist > 1e-8:
                normal_unit_vector = (particle.pos - closest_pt) / dist
            else:
                normal_unit_vector = np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
            contact_point = closest_pt
        else:
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            normal_unit_vector = (particle.pos - closest_pt) / dist
            contact_point = closest_pt
            
        r_vec = contact_point - self.drum_center
        surface_vel = np.array([-self.omega * r_vec[1], self.omega * r_vec[0]])
        
        rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
        overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal_unit_vector)
        tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal_unit_vector
        
        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

    def _closest_point_on_segment(self, p, a, b):
        ab = b - a
        ap = p - a
        ab_dot = np.dot(ab, ab)
        if ab_dot < 1e-12:
            return a
        t = np.dot(ap, ab) / ab_dot
        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, t))
        return a + t * ab
        
    def _is_inside(self, p):
        pts = [self.p1, self.p2, self.p3, self.p4]
        n = len(pts)
        sign = None
        for i in range(n):
            a = pts[i]
            b = pts[(i+1)%n]
            cross = (b[0] - a[0]) * (p[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (p[0] - a[0])
            if sign is None:
                sign = cross > 0
            elif (cross > 0) != sign:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_driving_torque(self, torque):
        self.applied_torque += torque
```

```python
"""Конфигурационные параметры симуляции DEM.

Все параметры задаются в системе СИ. Датакласс `SimulationConfig` хранит
значения по умолчанию, которые могут быть переопределены через GUI.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class SimulationConfig:
    """Параметры симуляции.

    При необходимости пользователь может изменить любые поля через GUI.
    """
    num_particles: int = 100
    particle_radius: float = 0.02          # м
    particle_density: float = 2500.0       # кг/м³
    kn: float = 1e5                        # N/m
    restitution_coeff: float = 0.9         # коэффициент восстановления
```

```python
import numpy as np

class Boundary:
    """Базовый класс границы."""
    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        raise NotImplementedError("Subclasses must implement detect_collision.")

class WallLine(Boundary):
    """Прямая стенка, ограничивающая область с внутренней стороны против нормали."""
    def __init__(self, point, normal):
        self.point = np.array(point, dtype=float)
        self.normal = np.array(normal, dtype=float)
        self.normal /= np.linalg.norm(self.normal)

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # Расстояние от центра частицы до линии (положительно – в сторону нормали)
        dist = np.dot(particle.pos - self.point, self.normal)

        if dist > 0:
            return None  # нет контакта

        overlap = particle.radius - dist
        contact_point = particle.pos - overlap * self.normal
        normal_unit_vector = -self.normal
        overlap_rate = np.dot(particle.vel, self.normal)
        tangential_velocity = particle.vel - overlap_rate * self.normal

        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

class WallCircle(Boundary):
    """Вращающийся барабан (окружность)."""
    def __init__(self, center, radius, omega=0.0):
        self.center = np.array(center, dtype=float)
        self.radius = radius
        self.omega = omega                # угловая скорость барабана
        self.applied_torque = 0.0         # реактивный момент от частиц

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        # Вектор от центра барабана к центру частицы
        vec = particle.pos - self.center
        dist = np.linalg.norm(vec)

        if dist > self.radius + particle.radius:
            return None  # нет контакта

        overlap = self.radius + particle.radius - dist
        if dist == 0.0:
            # Если частица точно в центре, выбираем произвольное направление
            normal = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
            contact_point = self.center + self.radius * normal
        else:
            normal = vec / dist
            contact_point = self.center + (self.radius / dist) * vec

        # Скорость поверхности барабана в точке контакта
        surface_vel = np.array([-self.omega * (contact_point[1] - self.center[1]),
                                self.omega * (contact_point[0] - self.center[0])])

        rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
        overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal)
        tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal

        return overlap, contact_point, normal, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

    def apply_driving_torque(self, torque):
        """Накопление реактивного момента, который необходимо компенсировать."""
        self.applied_torque += torque


class Lifter(Boundary):
    """Прямоугольный лифтер, жестко связанный с вращающимся барабаном."""
    def __init__(self, drum_center, drum_radius, height, width, base_angle, omega):
        self.drum_center = np.array(drum_center, dtype=float)
        self.drum_radius = drum_radius
        self.height = height
        self.width = width
        self.base_angle = base_angle
        self.omega = omega
        self.current_angle = base_angle
        self.applied_torque = 0.0
        
        self._update_corners()

    def _update_corners(self):
        r_out = self.drum_radius
        r_in = self.drum_radius - self.height
        
        tangent = np.array([-np.sin(self.current_angle), np.cos(self.current_angle)])
        
        center_out = self.drum_center + r_out * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
        center_in = self.drum_center + r_in * np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
        
        self.p1 = center_out - (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p2 = center_out + (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p3 = center_in + (self.width / 2) * tangent
        self.p4 = center_in - (self.width / 2) * tangent

    def update_time(self, t):
        self.current_angle = self.base_angle + self.omega * t
        self._update_corners()

    def detect_collision(self, particle):
        segments = [
            (self.p1, self.p2),
            (self.p2, self.p3),
            (self.p3, self.p4),
            (self.p4, self.p1)
        ]
        
        min_dist_sq = float('inf')
        closest_pt = None
        
        for p_a, p_b in segments:
            pt = self._closest_point_on_segment(particle.pos, p_a, p_b)
            dist_sq = np.sum((particle.pos - pt)**2)
            if dist_sq < min_dist_sq:
                min_dist_sq = dist_sq
                closest_pt = pt
                
        dist = np.sqrt(min_dist_sq)
        inside = self._is_inside(particle.pos)
        
        if not inside and dist >= particle.radius:
            return None
            
        if inside:
            overlap = particle.radius + dist
            if dist > 1e-8:
                normal_unit_vector = (particle.pos - closest_pt) / dist
            else:
                normal_unit_vector = np.array([np.cos(self.current_angle), np.sin(self.current_angle)])
            contact_point = closest_pt
        else:
            overlap = particle.radius - dist
            normal_unit_vector = (particle.pos - closest_pt) / dist
            contact_point = closest_pt
            
        r_vec = contact_point - self.drum_center
        surface_vel = np.array([-self.omega * r_vec[1], self.omega * r_vec[0]])
        
        rel_vel = particle.vel - surface_vel
        overlap_rate = np.dot(rel_vel, normal_unit_vector)
        tangential_velocity = rel_vel - overlap_rate * normal_unit_vector
        
        return overlap, contact_point, normal_unit_vector, overlap_rate, tangential_velocity

    def _closest_point_on_segment(self, p, a, b):
        ab = b - a
        ap = p - a
        ab_dot = np.dot(ab, ab)
        if ab_dot < 1e-12:
            return a
        t = np.dot(ap, ab) / ab_dot
        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, t))
        return a + t * ab
        
    def _is_inside(self, p):
        pts = [self.p1, self.p2, self.p3, self.p4]
        n = len(pts)
        sign = None
        for i in range(n):
            a = pts[i]
            b = pts[(i+1)%n]
            cross = (b[0] - a[0]) * (p[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (p[0] - a[0])
            if sign is None:
                sign = cross > 0
            elif (cross > 0) != sign:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_driving_torque(self, torque):
        """Накопление реактивного момента."""
        self.applied_torque += torque
```
